svg.aria-label: The default path: task-init, implementation-plan, approve-plan, implement-approved-slice or implement-fleet for a parallel wave, branch-commit, pr-package; impact-analysis and decision-interview join only on a named condition; the run ends at a draft PR, and task-close archives the task after the merge
svg.title: The default path
svg.text: One task, from task-init to a draft PR
creates the task folder, names any added step
only when a named condition fires
cuts the work into slices with exit criteria
a blinded review checks it against the decisions
one approved slice, a minimal diff
or implement-fleet: a wave of two or more, in parallel
shows the staged diff, then commits
pushes the task branch, opens a draft PR
read the draft PR, mark it ready for review, merge.
After the merge, task-close archives the task.
